messages.subject: Exon-junction microarrays
parts:
Hi

I would like to know if you recommend the FIRMA method for the
analysis of Affy exon-junction microarrays?
This platform contains exon and exon-junction probes. How will the
exon-junction probes affect the transcript estimates? Should we remove
(if the function allows it) the exon-junction probes to get the
transcript estimates?
I have been using FIRMA method for Affy Exon microarrays data
analysis, and I would like to compare the results of both platforms
(using a similar method).


Thank you in advance
Ana Rita Grosso
